subject: general
question: A and B can do a piece of work in 28 days and 35 days, respectively. They work on alternate days starting with A till the work gets completed. How long (in days) would it take A and B to complete the work?
solution:
Given:

A can do a piece of work in 28 days

B can do a piece of work in 35 days 

Formula Used:

Efficiency = Total work/No. of days

Calculation:

Total work be ( L.C.M of 28, 35) be140 unit.

Efficiency of A = work done by A in 1 day = 140/28 = 5 

Efficiency of B = work done by B in 1 day = 140/35 = 4 

Now, work done in 2 days = 9 

So, in 15 pair of 2 days they will complete 9 × 15 = 135 unit of work 

In 30 days 135 unit of work is done 

Remaining work = (140 - 135 ) = 5 unit 

As, they work alternately with A as first .So, on 31st day remaining 5 unit of work will be done by A.

So, No. of days taken to complete the whole work = 31 days

Hence, A and B takes 31 days to complete the work.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
